criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 9 the best, 2 and 1 strong. 3 a straight-on plan reading as an infographic, carrier about 25 px under the dek, lightest ground in the deck; 7 an even mid-grey waffle with the eight only 18 percent of the width and its label outside the safe zone; 4 and 5 well modelled but even dark-grey tail fields, 5's neck two caps with a gap; 8's tube racks primitive and its pool on empty floor; 6 a small tower in empty floor, near twin of 9. Type light on dark everywhere, nothing plated.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One accent, one meaning; measured count recurring; value track never strobes; casts consistent. Two grades (charcoal reliefs, navy hall); copper with two meanings; 6 and 9 near twins.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the speed held as his account; two Xeons a step removed; HPCwire reposts where the original is robots excluded. Nothing inferred past its source.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; no decision, deadline or concrete stake; the lab unplaced.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 6 and 9 land; 3 restates 1; the quote on 1, 3 and 9; 4 and 5 a detour.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, no house rule breaks; clerical rather than Texan; disclaimers recur; slide 8 reads as release copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Accent, hall and tray kit new; repeats no. 72's mix, raised-cell grid and molecular register.

one_sentence_fix: Shoot the count frames 3 and 7 the way frame 9 is shot, a raking three quarter camera with one flood pooling on the eight.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Even mid-grey waffle, no pool; label outside the safe zone at x 23.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low raking three quarter, one pool on the eight, field to black at the edges, label inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on plan reads as a chart; carrier 25 px under the dek; lightest ground.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raking three quarter, lowered 120 px, darker ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Even dark-grey tail fields; neck reads as two caps with a gap.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Continuous hourglass neck; low key so the rim and bundles carry the highlight.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Tube racks primitive; pool on empty floor, subject in half shade.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Centre the pool on the tower and the sliding tray; darken the open floor.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Small tower in empty floor, near twin of 9; pulled tray small.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: High three quarter close on the pulled tray.
